learning_outcomes.text: Apply a consistent model standard separating inputs, workings and outputs
Trace formula precedents and dependents to understand a model's logic
Detect and resolve errors and circular references using formula auditing
Document a model so a reviewer can follow and re-perform it
Run a structured model review and record the sign-off

integrative_case: A finance team inherits an undocumented pricing model before an audit: restructure it to a model standard, trace the logic with precedents and dependents, find and fix a circular reference, write an assumptions and version log, then run a structured review and record the sign-off with residual risks.

case-based decisions in the integrative case

source_reference.version_basis: Feature facts grounded in official Microsoft Excel documentation read via the Microsoft Learn MCP on 2026-10-02: formula precedents and dependents (Trace Precedents / Trace Dependents and the related Range APIs), formula auditing and error-checking including circular-reference detection. Governance practices (model standards, version control, sign-off) are Mastemy design content layered on those tool facts.
